title: Interval Garside groups arising from involutions in finite reflection groups
summary: We identify and study the interval Garside groups arising from the restriction of the absolute order on a Coxeter group to a lattice $[1,w]_T$, where $w$ is an involution. Those involutions $w$ for which $[1,w]_T$ is a lattice were previously classified by the second author; every such involution lies in the center of the parabolic subgroup generated by $[1,w]_T$. Except in type $B_n$, the obtained groups are isomorphic to (decomposable) right-angled Artin groups.
